description: This file defines a set of asynchronous functions to manage notes, including listing, fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes in a database, with associated tag handling. It acts as a service layer interfacing with a SQLAlchemy ORM model for notes and tags.

classes.name: ListNotesParams
classes.description: Immutable data class representing filtering parameters for listing notes.

methods.name: list[Tag] _ensure_tags( session: AsyncSession, *, names: list[str], user_id: uuid.UUID | None )
methods.description: Retrieves existing tags or creates new ones based on provided tag names, ensuring 1:1 correspondence with normalized names.

methods.name: dict _note_to_dto_dict(note: Note)
methods.description: Converts a Note ORM object into a dictionary suitable for external use.

methods.name: list[dict] list_notes_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, params: ListNotesParams, user_id: uuid.UUID | None )
methods.description: Fetches a list of notes with optional filters such as search query, tags, pinned status, and deletion status.

methods.name: dict get_note_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: uuid.UUID, user_id: uuid.UUID | None )
methods.description: Retrieves a single note by ID, raises NotFoundError if not found or inaccessible.

methods.name: dict create_note_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, title: str, content: str, tags: list[str], pinned: bool, favorited: bool, user_id: uuid.UUID | None, )
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title, content, tags, and flags for pinned and favorited, and returns its DTO.

methods.name: dict update_note_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: uuid.UUID, user_id: uuid.UUID | None, title: str | None = None, content: str | None = None, tags: list[str] | None = None, pinned: bool | None = None, favorited: bool | None = None, deleted: bool | None = None, )
methods.description: Updates mutable fields of an existing note and returns the updated DTO.

methods.name: None delete_note_flow( session: AsyncSession, *, note_id: uuid.UUID, user_id: uuid.UUID | None )
methods.description: Soft-deletes a note by setting its is_deleted flag to True.
